scope: Desktop Chromium web interaction through Rove-owned Playwright authority. The atlas covers standardized browser primitives and common ARIA widget contracts; site-specific business workflows remain compositions of these capabilities.

statusCodes.C: covered by the current production path and tests
statusCodes.P: partially covered or represented too coarsely
statusCodes.E: supported by an isolated experiment but not production
statusCodes.M: missing from the current production contract
statusCodes.H: requires explicit human control or confirmation by policy
statusCodes.N: not applicable to this pipeline stage

admissionRule: A capability is not production-supported until its complete applicable pipeline has deterministic tests, explicit effect verification, bounded evidence, stale-state recovery, and consequence-appropriate safety policy.

capabilities.name: Top-level URL navigation
capabilities.experiment: Redirect, timeout, replacement, and failure matrix.
capabilities.acceptance: Destination and provenance are verified without replay after uncertain dispatch.

capabilities.name: Back and forward history traversal
capabilities.experiment: Cross-document and same-document history fixture.
capabilities.acceptance: The successor document and revision are observed after each traversal.

capabilities.name: Reload current page
capabilities.experiment: GET, POST-resubmission, service-worker, and beforeunload reload cases.
capabilities.acceptance: Reload is explicit, revisioned, and never silently resubmits a consequential form.

capabilities.name: SPA, fragment, and same-document transitions
capabilities.experiment: pushState, replaceState, hash, and router transition fixture.
capabilities.acceptance: Material state change is distinguished from no-op URL churn and stale targets are invalidated.

capabilities.name: Open, enumerate, switch, and close pages
capabilities.experiment: Multiple tabs with concurrent close and focus races.
capabilities.acceptance: Stable page identity survives ordering and focus changes.

capabilities.name: Script and link-created popup capture
capabilities.experiment: Synchronous, delayed, blocked, and immediately closed popups.
capabilities.acceptance: Every opened page is correlated to the originating action or reported as browser-originated.

capabilities.name: Same-origin frame traversal and action
capabilities.experiment: Nested frames with reorder and document replacement.
capabilities.acceptance: Frame provenance is preserved and a replaced frame stales its targets.

capabilities.name: Cross-origin frame traversal and action
capabilities.experiment: Nested cross-origin frame, sandbox, CSP, and detach matrix.
capabilities.acceptance: Actionable frame targets retain origin-safe provenance and fail closed on detach.

capabilities.name: Before-unload confirmation
capabilities.experiment: Dirty editor close, reload, and cross-origin navigation fixture.
capabilities.acceptance: The browser prompt cannot be accepted without an explicit directive and outcome evidence.

capabilities.name: Foreground page and focus correlation
capabilities.experiment: Browser focus, page focus, popup, and human handoff transitions.
capabilities.acceptance: Rove reports active page, foreground page, and document focus without conflation.

capabilities.name: Native interactive HTML controls
capabilities.experiment: All native control types, disabled fieldsets, hidden options, and labels.
capabilities.acceptance: Supported visible native controls have correct kind, name, state, and capability.

capabilities.name: ARIA widget roles
capabilities.experiment: Every ARIA widget role with conforming and malformed variants.
capabilities.acceptance: Widget role is not collapsed to a generic control when it changes interaction semantics.

capabilities.name: ARIA state and value properties
capabilities.experiment: Expanded, pressed, selected, current, busy, invalid, required, readonly, and value-state matrix.
capabilities.acceptance: State used to choose or verify an action is revision-scoped and explicitly represented.

capabilities.name: ARIA ownership and controller relationships
capabilities.experiment: controls, owns, active-descendant, described-by, and flow-to graphs with cycles.
capabilities.acceptance: Composite-widget relationships are bounded, cycle-safe, and available to grounding.

capabilities.name: Accessible name and description
capabilities.experiment: Native, ARIA, shadow, frame, SVG, and duplicate-name cases.
capabilities.acceptance: Computed identity matches browser semantics; grounding ranks exact and direct-substring names before bounded contiguous whole-token sequences, and exposes ambiguity rather than guessing.

capabilities.name: Geometry, clipping, and occlusion
capabilities.experiment: Nested scroll, transforms, zoom, sticky overlays, and partial occlusion.
capabilities.acceptance: Action geometry and screenshot geometry share the same current observation authority.

capabilities.name: Open shadow-root controls
capabilities.experiment: Nested open roots with slots, duplicate labels, and host replacement.
capabilities.acceptance: Targets preserve root depth and stale on shadow-tree replacement.

capabilities.name: Closed shadow-root controls
capabilities.experiment: Visual observation and human takeover against closed-root widgets.
capabilities.acceptance: Rove identifies the semantic gap and requests human control instead of fabricating a target.

capabilities.name: Canvas and image-only application surfaces
capabilities.experiment: Canvas charts, maps, remote desktop, and image buttons with visual anchors.
capabilities.acceptance: Visual grounding stays inside a current bounded region and never bypasses semantic ambiguity.

capabilities.name: Virtualized and recycled collections
capabilities.experiment: Recycled rows, duplicate labels, delayed materialization, and list reordering.
capabilities.acceptance: A recycled DOM node cannot retain the identity of its previous logical item.

capabilities.name: Moving controls, toasts, live regions, and transient overlays
capabilities.experiment: Animations, live-region updates, toast expiration, and overlay races.
capabilities.acceptance: Transient evidence is timestamped and actionability requires current stable geometry.

capabilities.name: Primary single click
capabilities.experiment: Covered, moving, detached, navigating, and popup-opening controls.
capabilities.acceptance: Actionability is checked and successor state is reconciled after dispatch.

capabilities.name: Double click
capabilities.experiment: Single-click side effect versus double-click commit and timing matrix.
capabilities.acceptance: One semantic action emits exactly one bounded double-click sequence with no replay.

capabilities.name: Right click and context menu
capabilities.experiment: Native context menu, web contextmenu handler, and long-press alternative.
capabilities.acceptance: Web and browser-owned menus are distinguished; browser chrome requires human control.

capabilities.name: Modifier-assisted click
capabilities.experiment: Shift selection, platform accelerator, and new-tab link cases.
capabilities.acceptance: Modifier intent is explicit and platform mapping is recorded in evidence.

capabilities.name: Pointer hover
capabilities.experiment: Tooltip, delayed menu, overlay interception, and disappearing target cases.
capabilities.acceptance: Hover is grounded and transient successor surfaces are re-observed.

capabilities.name: Explicit focus and blur
capabilities.experiment: Focus-triggered validation, popup, and shadow/frame focus cases.
capabilities.acceptance: Focused target is directly verifiable and blur-triggered commits are consequence-aware.

capabilities.name: Targeted and page-level key press
capabilities.experiment: Logical keys, printable characters, repeat, and target-removal matrix.
capabilities.acceptance: Key dispatch is part of the verified interaction protocol with explicit expected effects.

capabilities.name: Keyboard chords and platform shortcuts
capabilities.experiment: ControlOrMeta, multi-modifier, reserved-browser, and app-handled shortcut matrix.
capabilities.acceptance: Reserved browser shortcuts are fenced and application effects are independently verified.

capabilities.name: Sequential focus navigation
capabilities.experiment: Positive tabindex, shadow DOM, modal trap, and composite roving-tabindex cases.
capabilities.acceptance: Every step reports the resulting focused semantic target or a bounded unknown.

capabilities.name: Tap and long press
capabilities.experiment: Touch-emulated tap, press duration, cancellation, and context-menu surfaces.
capabilities.acceptance: Touch capability is advertised only by a touch-capable provider and remains cancelable.

capabilities.name: Bounded position inside a semantic target
capabilities.experiment: Zoom, clipped targets, stale screenshot, and out-of-bounds offsets.
capabilities.acceptance: Coordinates remain target-relative and observation-scoped; arbitrary viewport coordinates are never exposed.

capabilities.name: Deterministic text replacement
capabilities.experiment: Input, textarea, contenteditable, framework-controlled, and sensitive fields.
capabilities.acceptance: The exact retained value is checked without leaking sensitive text into evidence.

capabilities.name: Character-by-character typing
capabilities.experiment: Key event ordering, masks, debounce, autocomplete, and rate-sensitive handlers.
capabilities.acceptance: Sequential typing is a single bounded request, never one connector call per character.

capabilities.name: Contenteditable plain-text editing
capabilities.experiment: Plaintext-only, nested editable, framework editor, and normalization cases.
capabilities.acceptance: Rove distinguishes exact plain replacement from rich-document editing.

capabilities.name: Date, time, number, range, and color inputs
capabilities.experiment: Type-specific valid, invalid, min, max, step, and locale-independent values.
capabilities.acceptance: Each input subtype has typed validation and a value-aware expected effect.

capabilities.name: Text selection, caret, and ranges
capabilities.experiment: Input selection, DOM range, direction, frame, shadow, and mutation cases.
capabilities.acceptance: Selection anchors are revision-scoped and verified before dependent editing.

capabilities.name: Rich-text document editing
capabilities.experiment: Paragraphs, lists, links, formatting, undo, and editor-specific mutation models.
capabilities.acceptance: Semantic edit plans verify document structure, not only visible text.

capabilities.name: IME and composition input
capabilities.experiment: Composition start, update, commit, cancellation, and non-Latin text matrix.
capabilities.acceptance: Rove does not claim composition support when only direct value replacement occurred.

capabilities.name: Autocomplete and suggestion acceptance
capabilities.experiment: Native datalist and ARIA manual, automatic, inline, grid, tree, and dialog popups.
capabilities.acceptance: Typed text, active suggestion, committed value, and popup state are separately represented.

capabilities.name: Clear editable value
capabilities.experiment: Required field, masked input, contenteditable, and blur-commit cases.
capabilities.acceptance: Empty retained value and any validation transition are independently observable.

capabilities.name: Constraint validation and form submission
capabilities.experiment: Required, pattern, custom validity, implicit Enter submit, and duplicate submit cases.
capabilities.acceptance: Validation failure, dispatched submit, navigation, and external commit are distinct outcomes.

capabilities.name: Undo and redo
capabilities.experiment: Native input, contenteditable, custom editor, and cross-field history cases.
capabilities.acceptance: Undo scope and resulting content are verified without assuming browser-wide history.

capabilities.name: Native and ARIA checkbox
capabilities.experiment: Checked, unchecked, mixed, disabled, and click-rejected cases.
capabilities.acceptance: Requested checked state is verified after action.

capabilities.name: Radio group selection
capabilities.experiment: Native and ARIA groups, required state, arrow navigation, and dynamic membership.
capabilities.acceptance: Group identity and exclusive selected value are verified, not only one radio's checked state.

capabilities.name: ARIA switch
capabilities.experiment: Click, Space, delayed state update, disabled, and rejected-toggle cases.
capabilities.acceptance: Switch is a distinct kind and its aria-checked transition is verified.

capabilities.name: Native single and multiple select
capabilities.experiment: Value, label, multiple, disabled option, optgroup, and dynamic options.
capabilities.acceptance: Exact selected values are verified without opening browser-native UI.

capabilities.name: ARIA combobox and listbox
capabilities.experiment: Editable and select-only comboboxes with list, grid, tree, and dialog popups.
capabilities.acceptance: Expansion, active descendant, option selection, committed value, and Escape cancellation are verified.

capabilities.name: Menu, menu button, and menubar
capabilities.experiment: Nested submenu, roving focus, checkbox item, radio item, and Escape closure.
capabilities.acceptance: Menu ownership, expanded path, focused item, and selected command are observable.

capabilities.name: Tabs and tab panels
capabilities.experiment: Automatic and manual activation, deletion, orientation, and lazy panel loading.
capabilities.acceptance: Selected tab and controlled visible panel are verified as one relationship.

capabilities.name: Native and ARIA slider
capabilities.experiment: Keyboard, pointer, vertical, reversed, stepped, and multi-thumb sliders.
capabilities.acceptance: Value bounds, step, orientation, and final numeric value are verified.

capabilities.name: Native and ARIA spinbutton
capabilities.experiment: Typing, increment, decrement, min, max, invalid, and localized display.
capabilities.acceptance: Numeric value and validity are typed and independently verified.

capabilities.name: Tree navigation and selection
capabilities.experiment: Expansion, selection, multi-select, typeahead, virtualization, and lazy children.
capabilities.acceptance: Item level, expanded state, selection, and logical parent are revision-scoped.

capabilities.name: Interactive grid and treegrid
capabilities.experiment: Cell navigation, row selection, edit mode, sort, virtualization, and tree expansion.
capabilities.acceptance: Logical row and cell identity survive recycling; focus and selection are distinct.

capabilities.name: In-page dialog and alertdialog
capabilities.experiment: Modal, nonmodal, nested, initial focus, focus return, and destructive confirmation.
capabilities.acceptance: Top-layer ownership, modal blocking, focused control, and close result are represented.

capabilities.name: Disclosure, details, and accordion
capabilities.experiment: Native summary/details and ARIA accordion with single and multiple expansion.
capabilities.acceptance: The trigger is groundable and expanded state is verified.

capabilities.name: Popover and tooltip surfaces
capabilities.experiment: Click, hover, focus, light-dismiss, anchor, and top-layer interactions.
capabilities.acceptance: Trigger relationship and open state are observed without mistaking a tooltip for a dialog.

capabilities.name: Toolbar and window splitter
capabilities.experiment: Roving toolbar focus and keyboard/pointer splitter resize.
capabilities.acceptance: Orientation, active control, and bounded split value are verified.

capabilities.name: Carousel and feed navigation
capabilities.experiment: Auto-rotation, pause, lazy feed loading, article navigation, and wraparound.
capabilities.acceptance: Current item and auto-advance state are observable and deterministic actions do not race rotation.

capabilities.name: JavaScript alert, confirm, and prompt
capabilities.experiment: Alert, confirm, prompt value, unexpected dialog, and simultaneous popup cases.
capabilities.acceptance: A directive is registered before the action and the chosen response is evidenced.

capabilities.name: Viewport scrolling
capabilities.experiment: Document, body, nested dominant surface, horizontal, and embedded PDF cases.
capabilities.acceptance: Actual movement and the owning scroll surface are reported.

capabilities.name: Grounded container scrolling
capabilities.experiment: Nested containers, overscroll, clipping, and no-movement boundary cases.
capabilities.acceptance: Scroll remains inside the grounded container and verifies offset change.

capabilities.name: Infinite and incremental scrolling
capabilities.experiment: Intersection-triggered loading, recycled rows, end detection, and rate limiting.
capabilities.acceptance: The loop has explicit progress, end, duplicate, and budget termination conditions.

capabilities.name: HTML negotiated drag and drop
capabilities.experiment: Multi-move dragover, allowed effect, nested target, autoscroll, and cancellation matrix.
capabilities.acceptance: A trusted staged gesture observes destination activation before exactly-once release.

capabilities.name: Pointer-driven custom drag
capabilities.experiment: Threshold, dwell, pointer capture, nested source, cancellation, and destination activation.
capabilities.acceptance: Gesture capability can be proposed without draggable metadata and remains pre-release cancelable.

capabilities.name: Move or reorder as a semantic transaction
capabilities.experiment: A menu transfer is executed through freshly grounded prepare, commit, and final verification observations under one consequence identity.
capabilities.acceptance: Destination membership is independently verified and an uncertain plan is never retried with another mechanism.

capabilities.name: Map, canvas, and viewport panning
capabilities.experiment: Map pan, canvas pan, pointer capture, inertia, and bounds.
capabilities.acceptance: Grounded surface and before/after viewport state prove movement without arbitrary coordinates.

capabilities.name: Touch swipe and pinch
capabilities.experiment: Touch-capable context, swipe thresholds, two-pointer pinch, cancel, and scroll conflict.
capabilities.acceptance: Provider capability and pointer count are explicit; desktop mouse emulation is not mislabeled as touch.

capabilities.name: Autoscroll during a held gesture
capabilities.experiment: Viewport and container edge autoscroll with source and destination mutation.
capabilities.acceptance: Held-button state, current geometry, and cancellation remain valid across every scroll step.

capabilities.name: Page and visual-viewport zoom
capabilities.experiment: Browser zoom, CSS zoom, pinch zoom, device scale, and screenshot correlation.
capabilities.acceptance: Every geometric observation declares its effective scale and old coordinates stale after change.

capabilities.name: Single file upload
capabilities.experiment: Direct file input, chooser trigger, cancel, rejected type, and successor upload state.
capabilities.acceptance: Only a Rove evidence artifact is materialized and upload acceptance is independently verified.

capabilities.name: Multiple-file and directory upload
capabilities.experiment: Multiple files, directory tree, relative paths, duplicate names, and partial rejection.
capabilities.acceptance: Every artifact and relative path is authorized; partial acceptance is explicit.

capabilities.name: Managed download capture
capabilities.experiment: Navigation, popup, blob, duplicate filename, interrupted, and late download cases.
capabilities.acceptance: Completed artifact path, size, filename, MIME identity with an explicit detection basis, origin action, and failure are durable evidence.

capabilities.name: Download progress and cancellation
capabilities.experiment: Large, slow, interrupted, canceled, resumed, and browser-close downloads.
capabilities.acceptance: In-progress, completed, failed, and canceled states are distinct and cleanup is deterministic.

capabilities.name: Cut, copy, and paste through trusted keyboard input
capabilities.experiment: Text, files, custom app move, empty clipboard, permission, and platform accelerator cases.
capabilities.acceptance: Clipboard intent is explicit, sensitive data is not evidenced, and effect is verified at the destination.

capabilities.name: Async Clipboard API and permission
capabilities.experiment: Granted, denied, prompt, user-activation, sensitive content, and revocation cases.
capabilities.acceptance: Rove never silently grants permission or exposes clipboard content in ordinary evidence.

capabilities.name: Media play, pause, mute, and captions
capabilities.experiment: Native controls, custom controls, autoplay block, mute, captions, and ended state.
capabilities.acceptance: Playback, mute, time, and active-track state are directly observable.

capabilities.name: Media seek and volume adjustment
capabilities.experiment: Seekable ranges, live media, buffering, volume, rate, and custom slider controls.
capabilities.acceptance: Requested media state is typed, bounded, and verified after asynchronous settling.

capabilities.name: Embedded documents, print, fullscreen, and picture-in-picture
capabilities.experiment: Built-in PDF viewer, print preview, fullscreen request, PiP, Escape, and download.
capabilities.acceptance: Web content, browser-owned UI, and operating-system surfaces have explicit ownership boundaries.

capabilities.name: Powerful-feature permission prompts
capabilities.experiment: Camera, microphone, location, notifications, clipboard, denial, grant, and expiration.
capabilities.acceptance: Permission state is observable but express consent stays under human or explicit preconfigured policy.

capabilities.name: Credential and secret entry
capabilities.experiment: Password, one-time code, manager autofill, reveal control, failed sign-in, and handoff.
capabilities.acceptance: Secrets are never persisted in observations or screenshots and authority is explicit for each entry.

capabilities.name: Passkeys, authenticators, and user verification
capabilities.experiment: Platform and roaming authenticators, cancellation, timeout, and conditional mediation.
capabilities.acceptance: Rove detects the ceremony and hands control to the user without simulating user verification.

capabilities.name: Payment and irreversible browser-owned confirmation
capabilities.experiment: Payment Request, merchant sheet, cancel, retry, shipping change, and final confirmation.
capabilities.acceptance: Final payment confirmation cannot be delegated through ordinary page interaction authority.

capabilities.name: CAPTCHA and human-verification challenges
capabilities.experiment: Checkbox, visual, audio, passive, interstitial, and false-positive challenge pages.
capabilities.acceptance: Presented verification is classified with evidence and always transfers control to the user.
